Subject: Cultural Festival- Intl food & craft from different countries

CULTURAL FESTIVAL
Wednesday, 30 April
12 - 2 pm
QA & QB courtyard (in Atrium round room if it rains)

Enjoy international food & craft from 10 different countries...
       

Everyone is invited to this exciting Cultural Festival organised by the International & Migrant Student Support Office. 
Stalls are all prepared by our very own Massey students. 

This year we will have the following stalls:
	New Zealand
	New Zealand- Maori
	China
	India
	Korea
	Malaysia
	Saudi
	South Africa
	USA
	Hong Kong

Please make sure you bring gold coins or come to enjoy free food from some of the stalls. 

DRESS UP FROM YOUR OWN BACKGROUND and come to support our students!!


Peggy Wang
International & Migrant Student Support Officer
Massey University, Auckland Campus
